_comment: TDD M4 reverse named-effort slice: EffectiveDialect (actual route dialect override) selects the Chat destination plan, not the provider default. Provider default is openai-responses; model route overrides to openai-chat. Future-expected exact (source: EffectiveDialect + snapshot pin). RED on baseline: hard refusal 400, zero upstream IO.
name: m4_reasoning_responses_chat_route_override_effective_dest
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.respup]
dialect = "openai-responses"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "prov-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-resp"
provider = "respup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
dialect = "openai-chat"
